newsitem.title: USA: California Microwave reviews business, delays Q2.
newsitem.headline: California Microwave reviews business, delays Q2.

text.p: California Microwave Inc said it is conducting a comprehensive review of its businesses, causing it to delay the release of its second quarter earnings results.
The company said it expects second quarter earnings will be profitable, barring any inventory or other adjustments that arise out of this review.
California Microwave said it now expects to report second quarter earnings on February 12, just prior to the filing ot the company's Form 10-Q report.
It said the review of businesses, assets and facilities spans both the second and third quarters, and is expected to result in substantial writedowns in these two quarters.

Rescheduling the second quarter results announcement was needed to allow management and the board of directors time to complete their review. The company said it has retained J.P. Morgan to aid in the review.

Chairman David Leeson said, "Most of our units are already consistently profitable. The board and the entire management are working together to bring all our operations up to that level. We're making progress, and we believe the outcome will benefit our shareholders."
